method.background: Use distinct six-second AMI ranges from eight rooms with no shared declared participants among the named earlier room bank at commit 2fdcae31. Select by hash on a three-second start grid, with at least five seconds of annotated speech and two seconds of simultaneous words by different speakers. Add one identical PCM background to each matched pair with its amplitude fixed from the original at nominal -5 dB. Apply one common peak-safe scale and quantize the two stems separately.
method.clock: Use one six-second view of each member. For cut-and-paste use the publisher's single interior region, require 0.20–1.00 s edit length and use an edit-containing crop chosen by hash on a 100 ms grid within both matched clocks. Target is supplied only to fixture preparation and evaluation. For resynthesis and infill use a common start at 0 s. Report infill clip-level flags only: the bounded prefix does not supply medium_edit.txt, and the cut-and-paste label is not assigned to infill.
method.comparison: Compare the stored five two-second window point and both frozen interval heads. Use no new training or point selection. Report flag counts separately from useful source locations and report paired original/variant transitions by condition. Reuse the earlier overlap criterion. Include each AMI background alone as a control.
method.sources: Take first 192 MiB from each of six pinned SINE shards. Find exact filename-stem matches between originals and each of the three treatments in its own shard. Exclude reader 100. Use hash order to select up to 12 pairs per treatment, at most one per reader within each treatment and no reused utterance across treatments. A reader may recur across treatments.
